findings.concern: Reusing full arch-report collection in arch-impact would execute report-only queries against legacy flat databases.
findings.resolution: Extract a lightweight shared collect_index_provenance reader; full report collection composes it, while impact invokes only that reader.

findings.concern: A database pathname and invocation digest do not establish a stable comparison identity.
findings.resolution: Publish schema/producers/coverage as observed facts. A future consumer compares producer name/version/soundness and exact coverage, while retaining digest only as provenance.

findings.concern: Missing producer or coverage tables could be rendered as a successful complete analysis.
findings.resolution: Serialize null/empty values verbatim and document them as absence, never completeness.

findings.concern: The new consumer-oriented metadata might change the impact reachability claim.
findings.resolution: It is JSON-only. Text/Markdown and MUST, bounded MAY and TOP semantics remain untouched; the existing full impact controls pass.

open: The following intake may implement a sidecar consumer only after it validates impact_input, index_provenance, the edge-kind contract and an explicit user-supplied corpus/configuration scope manifest.
